messages:
aisha: Quick weekly health check for Halo onboarding cohort. QoQ token consumption +28%, WoW +6%. Notable: latency drift and small error bump. 

 tom: Can you paste p50/p95 and spend deltas?

 aisha: p50 140ms, p95 520ms (was 380ms last week). Error rate 0.9% -> 1.4% WoW. Spend +9% WoW. Short snapshot:
```
metric       | QoQ    | WoW
tokens       | +28%   | +6%
requests     | +22%   | +4%
p50 latency  | 140ms  | +20ms
p95 latency  | 520ms  | +140ms
error rate   | 0.9%   | +0.5pt
spend        | +31%   | +9%
```

 diego: Any pattern on sequence length or a particular route?

 aisha: Sequence length median up from 320 -> 740 (demo ingestion spikes). Top source: `ingestion-worker-3` ~18% of tokens this week. Token density for embeddings route also up.

 priya: Renewal risk? Customer sentiment?

 aisha: Renewal risk low. Onboarding progress: 3/4 integrations done, last item is SSO which is blocked on partner. Customer NPS still positive. Latency is impacting demo flows though — could affect trial conversion if not addressed.

 tom: I've pinged eng-runtime and added a watch. Any quick mitigations we can try on CS side?

 diego: I'll try a temporary batching tweak: increase batch window by 10ms and bump KV cache TTL for this cohort. Running patch now. ETA ~45m, will monitor p95 and error-rate.

 cs-bot: Report generated: `/reports/halo_weekly_3234560000.csv` (uploaded)

 priya: I'll schedule a 30m enablement session for next Tue and update the playbook with guidance on input size limits.

 aisha: Action items: 1) diego — batching tweak & monitor; 2) tom — watch error spikes + rollback plan; 3) priya — enablement + customer note; 4) aisha — update CS ticket and next-week snapshot. Will post follow-up in morning. :thumbsup:
